T16.text:
Hi {{contact.first_name}},

Have you ever looked at your ad account and thought, “I honestly have no idea if any of this is working”?

I hear this from wedding business owners all the time.

Sometimes they’re paying an agency every month. Sometimes they’re managing their own ads.

Either way, there’s plenty of data, but no clear answer to the question that matters:

**Is any of this leading to bookings?**

I was talking with one of our Ads Accelerator clients recently, and she described exactly what that felt like.

During the first half of last year, her venue spent more than $22,000 on ad spend and agency fees.

Every month, they received reports showing impressions and clicks.

What they couldn’t see was whether those clicks were turning into inquiries. There wasn’t even conversion tracking in place.

When leadership asked whether their advertising was working, she didn’t have a clear answer.

Eventually, she decided to take advertising into her own hands.

She wanted to learn. She just didn’t want to figure it out alone anymore.

Together, we rebuilt the foundation.

We launched new campaigns, installed conversion tracking, and helped her create a landing page using our recommendations and frameworks.

Just as importantly, we helped her understand what was working, what wasn’t, and how to make decisions about her campaigns.

During the first half of this year, her venue spent about $6,000 on ads.

**That investment generated nearly $70,000 in wedding bookings directly attributable to those campaigns.**

The numbers are exciting. But what stood out to me was how different her relationship with her marketing had become.

Before, she was spending money without knowing what it was producing.

Now, she can connect that investment to inquiries and bookings—and use what she’s learning to decide what to do next.

That’s an important distinction.

The goal isn’t simply to take over the tasks your agency used to handle. It’s to understand your advertising well enough that you’re no longer making decisions in the dark.

You don’t have to choose between handing everything over and figuring everything out alone.

If you want to manage your own ads with experienced guidance in your corner, that’s exactly why we built the Ads Accelerators.

Reply with “Accelerators,” and we can talk through whether it’s the right fit for your business.

Whitney

T26.text:
Your content can still be useful long after the algorithm stops showing it.

That’s the frustrating part of relying on organic reach. You put thought into a post that helps couples understand your value, and its visibility fades before many of them ever see it.

The message hasn’t stopped being relevant.
It’s just stopped being distributed.

Organic content has a role in building trust. But when it’s your only source of visibility, you’re relying on a distribution system you have very little control over.

A thoughtful ad strategy gives you more control over who you reach and keeps your strongest messaging working beyond its initial moment in the feed.

The goal isn’t to keep creating more content.
It’s to build a system that makes better use of what you create.

If you’re ready to understand how ads fit into that system, explore our Accelerator programs. We help you think like an ads strategist—not just learn which buttons to click.

T06.text:
SUBJECT: Your Google Ads shouldn’t be a horror show 💀

PREVIEW TEXT: Less guesswork. A clearer strategy. No jump scares. 🎃

Happy Halloween, {{contact.first_name}}!

We love a classic scary movie. But your Google Ads account? Not the place for a horror show.

Spending money without understanding what’s happening is unsettling. Especially when you’re left wondering whether those clicks will ever turn into booked weddings.

But the goal isn’t just to make Google Ads feel less intimidating.

It’s to understand how they fit into a system that helps couples find you, feel confident in your business, and take the next step.

Here’s what that looks like:

**Start with what happens after the click.**

Your ad gets someone to your website. Your website needs to help them decide. Does your landing page make it clear who you’re for, why you’re a good fit, and how to inquire?

**Make follow-up part of the strategy.**

An inquiry isn’t a booking yet. A prompt, personal response helps keep the conversation moving. Automation can help you respond quickly without making couples feel like they’re talking to a robot.

**Build around the right searches.**

A bigger budget isn’t a substitute for a thoughtful setup. Your keywords, ads, and landing page should work together to connect what a couple is searching for with what you offer.

**Know what the numbers are telling you.**

Clicks tell you people are arriving. Inquiries and bookings help you understand whether that traffic is supporting your business. The value of data is in the decisions it helps you make.

You don’t need to know everything before you start.

But you do deserve to understand what you’re investing in—and why.

That’s what we focus on inside the **Google Search Accelerator**:

✨ We walk you through the strategy.  
✨ We build your campaign with you.  
✨ We support you as it runs and evolves.

If you want guidance without handing everything over, join our live info session. We’ll walk through how it works so you can decide whether it’s the right fit.

👉 **Register for the Live Info Session — November 5**

No tricks. Just a clearer way forward.

XO,  
Daniela & Whitney

I taught a training this morning that technically had nothing to do with running ads.

No targeting, keywords, or campaign settings.

Instead, we spent the workshop inside The VAULT helping our Google Ads and Meta Ads Accelerator members define their unique value propositions. We worked through questions like:

- Who are you particularly well suited to serve?
- What are those clients really trying to create through their wedding?
- What do you do especially well that actually matters to them?
- Which things you’ve been calling “differentiators” are meaningful reasons to choose you, and which could be said by 20 competitors?

These questions have a lot to do with whether a couple will read your ad, visit your landing page, and feel like your business is worth a conversation.

Because before we can communicate why someone should choose you, we need to understand what makes you a meaningful choice for them.

This is the part of advertising that doesn’t happen inside the ad platform.

And it’s work we do together inside the Accelerators. You don’t need to arrive with all of these answers figured out.

I think that’s an important distinction when you’re deciding what kind of support you need to run ads.

Buying a course can leave you with 47 videos and a blank Ads Manager staring back at you. Even when you understand the instructions, you’re still responsible for figuring out how they apply to your business.

Inside our Accelerators, we help you work through those decisions.

We clarify your messaging, build your initial campaigns with you, and help you understand the data so you can learn how to make informed decisions about what comes next.

You’re building an advertising system around your business, with someone beside you who knows what that system needs to look like.

This morning, that meant stepping away from campaign settings and getting clearer on why the right couple would choose you. That clarity gives us something meaningful to build the ads around.

If this sounds like the kind of support you’ve been looking for, reply and tell me where you are with ads right now. We can talk through whether an Accelerator would be a good fit.

Whitney
